contract.validation: Strict exact-field OpenAPI/runtime model; both IDs bind to their path values. Counts are non-negative PostgreSQL BIGINT values. If breakdown_suppressed is true, every phase count is NULL; otherwise every phase count is present and is either zero or at least five. Phase counts are not additive and do not represent verified person totals.
contract.privacy: The response contains only coarse consent-filtered phase counts and suppression state. It excludes adopter references, cohorts, event types, timestamps, evidence, and identity.
contract.authorization: Existing private exact-location solution_lifecycle:read policy and signed tenant context are unchanged.

rollback: Revert the Gateway model/route, focused test, and progress/evidence records; no database rollback is needed.
